checks.title: Personal host pools use Start VM on Connect
Pooled host pools have at least two session hosts
Premium file storage is reached through a private endpoint
Premium file storage is zone-redundant
Session hosts run Trusted launch with Secure Boot and vTPM on
Host pools turn drive and USB redirection off
Defender for Cloud's Servers plan is on
Premium file storage allows only GCM SMB channel encryption, AES-128-GCM included
Subscriptions holding AVD have at least one Azure Policy assignment in scope
No policy assignment in scope is left in DoNotEnforce mode
Application groups use group-based assignment with no direct user assignments
Host pools with Entra-joined hosts enable Entra single sign-on
Conditional Access enforces MFA for AVD and Windows Cloud Login
AVD Conditional Access policies exclude emergency-access (break-glass) accounts
Azure Files Entra Kerberos service principal is configured and excluded from MFA CA
Session hosts requesting Intune enrollment are managed in Intune
Intune-managed session hosts have zero noncompliant devices
Intune tenant marks devices without a compliance policy as noncompliant
Intune Settings Catalog delivers an FSLogix profile container policy
Host pools have no orphaned Intune device records for deleted session hosts
OneDrive Silent Account Configuration and Known Folder Move are enabled for session hosts
Microsoft 365 Apps Shared Computer Activation is enabled for multi-session hosts
Microsoft Teams VDI media optimization is enabled for session hosts
Power Platform day-2 workflows run in a dedicated environment outside Default
Power Platform DLP policy covers the AVD environment and blocks unapproved connectors
Power Platform enterprise policy injects environments into a delegated VNet subnet
